title: "TDM run results for v10.0-beta.2 are published"
description: "Base year 2023 and RTP needs-year scenarios on the v10.0-beta.2 network, with every run traceable to its model version."

The [TDM run results site](https://wfrcanalytics.github.io/WF-TDM-Runs/){target="_blank"} now reports run sets for the Wasatch Front travel demand model. The v10.0-beta.2 set includes a base year 2023 scenario and RTP needs-year scenarios for 2036, 2046 and 2055.

Each run records the model version, settings and outputs that produced it, so results can be reproduced. Other run sets on the site cover accessible jobs, a household location burden index and several commute-shortening sensitivity tests.

For model documentation of record, see the [Travel Demand Model](../../models/tdm.qmd) page.
